QuestInfo.name: Frostprey
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2081003##k says he found a good place to hatch Freezer.
QuestInfo.1: #p2081003# thinks the highest nest in the sky should be able to hatch it. Sounds good.  Let's go there. \n\n#o9300090# #r#a62431#
QuestInfo.2: I can use the power of Frostprey now!

0.0: It should be able to hatch in a nice place where it can open its wings. A modest wind, large, open space...I've got it!
0.1: I found a place to hatch Frostprey. The Sky nest. The highest nest is the perfect place to hatch Frostprey. It's not too high for you I believe...
0.2: Take the egg there. Hurry! Wake #r#o9300090##k up. I'd go with you, but I don't have my longjohns on...besides, I feel that you should reap the reward...if you're strong enough that is...so what do you say?

yes.0: Ok, then hurry up! Wake #r#o9300090##k up. Be careful though, #o9300090# might attack you the second it hatches!

1.0: Ah! This is #o9300090#! Sturdy beak! Ouch! Cold feathers! Eyes as cold as winter itself! Fantastic!
1.1: #o9300090# hatched, thanks to you. As much as I'd like to look after this creature, it belongs to you now.
1.2: Did this magnificent bird attack you? I thought it might! They tend to have strong identities so they don't recognize, or obey, humans unless defeated by one. Because you won, he decided to follow you. I envy your strength! I should gone to the sky nest. You can even raise #o9300090# so it will assist you in battle! I am so jealous...this is fine bird, don't you think?

yes.0: Take care of it please. Show it to me some day when you've grown strong! Thank you.

mob.0: Still waiting for it to hatch? Come on, you can do it!
